<p>*Publish date: 2017-04-22* The 15th China International Machine Tooling Show (CIMT2017) was held with great success from April 17 to 22, 2017! Sharpen New Materials products appeared at Booth W7-418! Professor He Yuehui, Chief Project Expert of Sharpen New Materials, attended this exhibition with a doctoral R&D team and a sales team. At this exhibition, Sharpen New Materials displayed SAP powder metallurgy high-speed steel molding products: taps, cutter heads, end mills, shovel drill bits, valve seat rings, mold guide posts, etc. Cermet bond diamond/CBN grinding wheels for the machining of superhard bodies of revolution, blades, and hard and brittle materials such as sapphire and zirconia. Cutting-edge industry technology attracted users and experts from home and abroad to discuss and exchange with Sharpen, consult on product information, and learn about product details. For a long time, powder metallurgy high-speed steel and grinding wheels for machining superhard materials have relied almost entirely on imports. Through persistent and unceasing R&D, today, the wise people of Sharpen have trodden a path of innovation, built up core preparation technology with independent intellectual property rights, and achieved domestication of these two major product categories, providing full-series solutions to manufacturing and processing enterprises.</p>
